expectedIssues: Profile is highlighted in the bottom nav bar while the home feed is shown
reportedIssues: The favorite/heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use inconsistent styling: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a dark outlined heart on a white circular background, while the pizza card below shows a white heart on a dark/near-black circular background.
